name: Configure Scheduled Backup for All Domains
description:
Set up a scheduled backup job in Virtualmin that backs up all three virtual servers (acmecorp.test, brightstar.test, greenvalley.test). Configure the backup with the following requirements:

1. The backup should include ALL three domains.
2. The backup destination should be a local directory: /backup/virtualmin/ (create this directory if it does not exist).
3. The backup should be scheduled to run daily.
4. The backup should include these features: home directory files, mail files, MySQL databases, and DNS zone.
5. Set the backup to keep only the 7 most recent backups (delete older ones).
